schema.description: Optional create settings. Unknown-only input is refused; extra unknown fields alongside supported fields produce warnings. call_retention_days is inherited on create and must be omitted.

func_end_call.description: Voice silence/duration timer gate, not a blanket prohibition on END_CALL.

func_cold_transfer.description: Compatibility-only; not the effective transfer permission.

func_send_sms.description: Compatibility-only; use incall_sms_enabled for in-call SMS.

record_call.description: Agent recording default; an explicit number true/false wins.

greet_by_name.description: Inbound name-greeting hint, independent of remembering callers; not global anonymization.

remember_callers.description: Phone caller context/learning; false does not erase saved records or website visitor history.

system_prompt.description: Up to 3,000 tokens when knowledge prompt checks are enabled; otherwise up to 16,000 characters. The 100,000-character input ceiling is for counting, not the accepted prompt size.

welcome_message.default: Hello! How can I help you today?

llm_model.description: Compatibility-only; does not select the runtime model.

fallback_message.default: I am sorry, could you say that again?

post_call_sms_template.description: No endpoint default; supply a template when enabling post-call SMS.

timezone.description: Nonempty IANA time zone. When omitted, use the valid account time zone or UTC.

voicemail_message.description: Required and nonblank when voicemail_leave_enabled is true; no endpoint default.

interruption_sensitivity.description: Stored compatibility value; does not tune current interruption decisions.

max_call_duration_seconds.description: Null uses the runtime fallback; it does not mean unlimited.

speaking_rate.description: Existing numeric clamp to 0.5..1.5. Null or empty clears.

pickup_delay.description: Legacy input handling and default (10) unchanged in this release.

recording_source.description: provider or nixflex (case/space normalized); null/empty clears to provider.

choices.description: Required non-empty for selector; whitespace-only choices rejected.

post.description: Create an agent with optional settings. An empty JSON object is valid. Omitted settings use normal creation defaults; this operation has no general idempotency guarantee.

get.description: Owned agents; active by default. Optional status/search. Stable created_at DESC, agent_id DESC ordering. Bare array. Strict bounds: invalid queries return 400 invalid_agent_list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Strict decimal integer; no signs, fractions, leading zeros or repeated values. Invalid values return 400 invalid_agent_list; not clamped.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Strict decimal integer. Pages are not a snapshot during concurrent writes.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal name/agent_id substring. Trim outer whitespace; empty means no search. Control characters forbidden. No wildcard or regex syntax.

items.description: One safe projection for create, update, get and list. No secrets or automatic future-column exposure.

get.description: Owned public numbers only; pending imports and internal browser identities are hidden. Without limit/cursor the legacy envelope stays unchanged. count is returned rows, not total. Paged reads order by created_at DESC NULLS LAST, phone_number DESC; live traversal, not a snapshot.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Opts into cursor paging; 1–100. Omitted with a cursor defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page; keep the same account and filters.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Only numbers assigned to this agent.

200.description: count is this page size. next_cursor and has_more are present only in paged mode.

source.description: Descriptive origin, never a permission or writable setting.

web_calls_enabled.description: Saved switch; website voice also needs Web agent ON.

voicemail_leave_enabled.description: This number's own voicemail setting - the ONLY one that applies to API-imported numbers. null = not set = silent hangup on voicemail.

require_booking_confirmation.description: true / false for this number, null = inherit the agent. See /actions/booking-confirmation.

recording_source.description: Who records on this number. null = inherit the agent.
